Accessibility Statement

Last updated: 21 May 2026

Our Commitment to Accessibility

A8Z is committed to making this website accessible to people with disabilities, in line with the international WCAG 2.1 Level AA standard and the Israeli IS 5568 standard, as required by the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 5773-2013.

We have designed and built the site to be usable with a keyboard, with screen-reader software, and at increased zoom levels — and we continue to test and improve it.

Conformance Level

The site aims to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and the Israeli standard IS 5568 (which is based on WCAG 2.0 AA). Conformance was reviewed against the success criteria for Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust content.

Accessibility Features Implemented

  • Skip-to-content link visible on keyboard focus
  • Visible keyboard focus indicator on every interactive element
  • Semantic HTML landmarks (header, main, nav, footer) and a logical heading hierarchy
  • Form labels for every input, with required-field indication and accessible error messages
  • Color contrast meets the 4.5:1 ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text and UI components
  • The site honors the prefers-reduced-motion system preference
  • Decorative images and icons are marked appropriately; meaningful icons have accessible names
  • The site is fully responsive and remains usable at 200% browser zoom

Known Limitations and Exceptions

We are not aware of material accessibility limitations at the time of last update. Any third-party services or integrations embedded in the site are operated by external providers; if you experience an accessibility issue with one of them, please contact us via the details below and we will work with the provider or replace the integration.

Accessibility Coordinator

If you encounter an accessibility issue, or have a question, suggestion or request relating to accessibility on this site, please contact our accessibility coordinator:

Name: Or Alperovitz
Email: or@a8z.biz

We will do our best to respond within two business days and resolve verified issues promptly.

How to Report an Accessibility Issue

When reporting a problem, please include the following so we can reproduce and fix it quickly:

  • The page address (URL) where the issue occurred
  • A short description of what was hard, broken, or unclear
  • Your browser and device (e.g., Chrome on iPhone, Firefox on Windows)
  • Any assistive technology you were using (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver, ZoomText)

Updates to This Statement

We review this statement at least once a year and after any significant change to the website. The last review date is shown at the top of this page.
